# Newark Law Offices

> Boutique legal representation and strategic advocacy serving corporate and individual clients throughout Texas and Oklahoma.

Newark Law Offices (legal entity: A Newark Firm, LLC) provides litigation, corporate advocacy, bankruptcy, foreclosure defense, personal-injury (car-accident), and insurance-claim counsel with offices in Dallas, Texas and Edmond, Oklahoma.

- Responsible attorney: Robert C. Newark, III (Texas and Oklahoma state courts; federal courts in Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, New Mexico, and Arkansas)
- Attorney Tyler Wilson: licensed in Oklahoma, Alaska, Wisconsin, and South Dakota state courts
- Alaska, Wisconsin, and South Dakota originating matters are accepted on a referral basis
- Local counsel: case-by-case in licensed courts — https://newarkfirm.com/local-counsel.html
- Phone: 866-230-7236 | Dallas: 972-332-5733 | Edmond: 405-727-0269
- Case review: https://newarkfirm.com/case-eligibility.html
- Chat widget and lead forms post to the firm’s Cloudflare Worker; they do not create an attorney-client relationship
- Content library: https://newarkfirm.com/insights.html (the former Blog section redirects here)

- [Foreclosure timelines in Texas and Oklahoma](https://newarkfirm.com/insights/foreclosure-timelines-texas-oklahoma.html): Texas non-judicial vs Oklahoma judicial calendars

- [Chapter 11 from the creditor side](https://newarkfirm.com/insights/chapter-11-creditor-strategy.html): proofs of claim, collateral, plan objections

- [Texas-Oklahoma corporate transactions](https://newarkfirm.com/insights/texas-oklahoma-corporate-transactions.html): diligence when assets sit in both states
